# TakeMeOnline

> TakeMeOnline helps offline businesses build a digital presence with a professional website, a Google Business Profile, local SEO and social media setup, at a fixed one-time price.

## Services

- [Website design](https://takemeonline.com/#services): Fast, mobile-friendly websites that make it easy for customers to call, message or visit.
- [Local SEO and Google Business Profile](https://takemeonline.com/#services): Google Business Profile setup, on-page SEO and consistent listings for Google Search and Maps.
- [Social media](https://takemeonline.com/#services): Instagram and Facebook profiles, branded templates and a simple content plan.

## Pricing

- [Starter, ₹9,999 one-time](https://takemeonline.com/#pricing): One-page website, Google Business Profile setup and WhatsApp button. Live in 7 days.
- [Growth, ₹24,999 one-time](https://takemeonline.com/#pricing): Website of up to 5 pages, local SEO, Google Business Profile optimisation and two social media profiles. Live in 7 days.
- [Pro, ₹49,999 one-time](https://takemeonline.com/#pricing): Website of up to 10 pages, online booking or a product catalogue, advanced local SEO and 30 days of social media content. Live in up to 14 days.

All packages include a domain and hosting for the first year.

## Pros and cons of taking a business online

- Pros: more customers can find the business on Google and Maps, enquiries can arrive at any hour, and photos, prices and reviews build trust.
- Cons: an upfront cost, ongoing upkeep, search results that take time to build, and public reviews that need replies.

## Key facts

- Customers: local and offline businesses, including shops, restaurants, cafes, clinics, salons, gyms, schools, colleges, coaching centres, hotels, real estate agents, car and bike workshops and home-service providers.
- Area served: India.
- Ownership: the domain, website content and business profiles are registered in the customer's business name.
- Team: a real development team, not a low-cost template reseller.
- Technical knowledge needed: none.
- Rankings: TakeMeOnline does not guarantee a specific Google ranking, because Google controls its own results.
- Last updated: 2026-11-01.
